findings.passage: If you’re planning to vote by mail in the Nov. 3 general election, please remember that the county election office must receive your application for a mail-in or absentee ballot by 5 p.m. on Tuesday, Oct. 27.
findings.note: Her emailed newsletter gives the mail ballot application deadline and says returned mail ballots must arrive by 8 p.m. on election day with the line 'A postmark is not enough!'. It says nothing about ID.
